title: Community spotlight ministries (C1/C2)
description: Published as /ministries.json and pinned by sha256 in manifest.community. The app ignores entries with test:true in release builds. The seed script (backend/scripts/seed-month.mjs) reads the same file.

id.description: Stable, used in Firestore doc ids (YYYY-MM_id). Never reuse or rename once featured.

months_featured.description: UTC months (YYYY-MM) in which this ministry is in the spotlight vote.

category.description: Comma-separated categories shown above the name, e.g. "Relief, Development". Optional.

image.description: Card image: an https URL on our Firebase Hosting site or in our project's Firebase Storage bucket (community.image_problems). Optional: the app draws a tinted fallback with a category icon.

amountPlanned.description: Reserved. The app ignores it: no amount is shown before a vote ends.

test.description: Debug builds only; never shown in release.

category_i18n.description: category in other languages, by language code (the app falls back to English category).

image_credit.description: Photographer and licence, shown on the card; required by CC BY / BY-SA images (e.g. "Jane Doe, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons"). Source page in images/CREDITS.md.
